bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH THURSDAY EVENING... Combined seas 15 to 18 ft with breakers covering the bar. Bar conditions severe. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 445 PM Wednesday, 515 AM Thursday, and 530 PM Thursday. The Wednesday and Thursday afternoon ebbs will be very strong.
bar.seas: 15 to 18 ft with breakers covering the bar
bar.ebb: afternoon ebbs will be very strong
